mapper.insert: insert into sys_email_code (email, code, type, expire_time, create_time) values (#{email}, #{code}, #{type}, #{expireTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from sys_email_code where email = #{email} and type = #{type}
mapper.select: select id, email, code, type, expire_time as expireTime, create_time as createTime from sys_email_code where email = #{email} and type = #{type} order by create_time desc limit 1
